note: Draft 1: hard pass (ids 24:4/24:4b, 24:7/24:7b). Soft flags accepted: 24:4 first colon +7 and second −3 ('agem iniquamente * em vão' — supervácue stands alone after the mediant in the Latin); 24:6 first colon −6 (Reminíscere … Dómine is long in Latin); 24:8, 24:9 second colons +5/+4 (the relative 'aos que cometem faltas', the Latin's participle); 24:13, 24:14, 24:21 +3/+4; 24:16, 24:22 −3. Rhyme: 24:19 multiplicaram / odiaram (mended in draft 2 by the Latinist's tense).

Draft 1. One major (24:19); the marks confirmed in all 23 verses. «A tradução conserva adequadamente o conteúdo latino nos demais versículos, inclusive suas construções incomuns.» Passed in particular 'esperam por vós', 'em vão', 'Encaminhai-me', 'não corarei', 'sereis propício ao meu pecado', 'se demorará entre coisas boas', 'libertai-me', the verbless 24:15 and the hanging 24:14.

outcomes.remark: MAJOR: odérunt is a perfect with present sense; 'odiaram' puts the hatred in the past → 'me odeiam'
outcomes.reason: As 17:18 'que me odeiam'; it also mends the stylist's rhyme.

note: Draft 1. Six verses; best 24:18, worst 24:14. «Os principais tropeços vêm de elipses e ordens de palavras que fazem ouvir a construção latina antes da oração portuguesa.» Five taken (two in another form), one mended otherwise.

outcomes.remark: 'lembrai-vos de mim, vós' — the isolated 'vós' sounds like an afterthought → 'vós lembrai-vos de mim'
outcomes.reason: In another form: 'lembrai-vos vós de mim' (the stressed subject after the imperative; his order reads as an indicative). tu kept.

outcomes.remark: hidden subject; 'firmar uma lei' unnatural → 'O Senhor lhe estabeleceu uma lei'
outcomes.reason: The subject supplied as a pronoun (D2): 'ele lhe firmou'. 'estabelecer' is constitúere's; naming the Lord kept as an option.

outcomes.remark: the ellipsis sounds interrupted → 'e a sua aliança é para que lhes seja manifestada'
outcomes.reason: A copula (D2); the Latin's purpose clause whole.

outcomes.remark: verbless opening → 'Os meus olhos estão sempre voltados para o Senhor'
outcomes.reason: The draft's option 2 and the respícere row's build (10:5b).

outcomes.remark: 'multiplicaram-se' spoils the mediant cadence; the object-first second colon piles up inversions
outcomes.reason: Order only: 'se multiplicaram: * libertai-me das minhas necessidades'.

outcomes.remark: multiplicaram / odiaram rhyme → 'e me odeiam com ódio iníquo'
outcomes.reason: The Latinist's 'me odeiam' removes the rhyme; his order would end on the proparoxytone 'iníquo'.

note: Draft 1. 34 items, 7 unknown words (corarei ×2, iniquamente, veredas, propício, esteio, iníquo). The deliberate tests: 24:11 'sereis propício ao meu pecado' heard FIRST as forgiving the sin, 'favouring the sin' second, and 'propício' listed unknown; 24:7 'ignorâncias' heard as faults of ignorance (right); 24:17 'necessidades' as privations, 'especially material' (straits, near enough); 24:15 (draft 1 verbless) understood. 'esperam por vós' / 'por vós esperei' heard as waiting for God to act — the Latin's sustinére, kept apart from speráre in (24:20). 'agem iniquamente em vão' heard as 'without result', 'without cause' second — both the Latin's supervácue. 24:12 subject heard as the Lord even unnamed; 24:13 'coisas boas' as well-being; 24:22 Israel as the biblical people, the modern state audible.

outcomes.remark: 'propício' unknown; 'favourable to the sin' as a second reading
outcomes.reason: The first hearing is the Latin's (forgive); 'perdoareis' would merge with dimíttere two verses later (24:18). Kept for Gustavo's ruling; the family has 7 lines (78:9 'propítius esto peccátis nostris').
Glossary erubéscere → corar (open), apart from confúndi in the same psalm; evidence added to the row.
The family of iníquo / iniquidade (glossary); the sense was heard.
